speechImpulse.citation: The appraised impulse of hearing a speech in person, on the core's life-change scale. Political persuasion effects from a single message are small on average (Coppock 2023, Persuasion in Parallel, University of Chicago Press), so a speech weighs less than a life event. Spread 0.1 to 0.5.

speechRetellWeight.citation: Weight on how far the speech moved the listener's stance when deciding whether to retell it; people talk about what affected them (Berger 2014, Journal of Consumer Psychology 24(4):586-607, on word of mouth). Spread 3 to 10.

speechSociabilityWeight.citation: Weight on the listener's trait lean toward retelling over keeping it (every trait through the shared trait table, about -1 to 1; OPUS-TRAITS, Oct 12, 2026) in deciding whether to retell. Doubled from 0.5 on sociability alone (-2 to 2) so the term keeps its range. Spread 0.5 to 2.

speechKeepPull.citation: The pull of not retelling, against which retelling is weighed. Checked so that some, not all, listeners retell a speech that moved them. Spread 0.3 to 1.
